review_information.notes: Permanent non-consumable future expansion for Regiere Deutschland. Requires the main campaign entitlement granted by regiere_deutschland_one_time or the complete bundle regiere_deutschland_complett_packet_one. The product regiere_deutschland_one_time_two grants only the zukunft_2050 entitlement. After completing the main campaign in 2026, the game offers this expansion and continues the same save through 2050. Includes 200 scenario decisions and 75 additional events per complete run. All future events are fictional. Purchase and restore use Apple's StoreKit through RevenueCat. No account is required. No subscription, trial, or automatic renewal. Available in the existing selected territories; prices and availability are unchanged.
